This latest round (allotted in April 2026) follows a series of smaller capital raises over the previous 24 months. Astral Systems previously secured a £3.5m seed round in July 2024. Other funding events include a £730k raise in January 2025 and a £500k injection in May 2025. The company also recorded smaller allotments of £250k and £135k in June 2024, alongside a £25k raise in February 2025. ... The £19.4m figure represents the largest single funding event for the company since its incorporation. By producing radioisotopes through compact reactors, the business provides an alternative to traditional large-scale nuclear infrastructure for medical and industrial sectors. The company focuses on the manufacture of basic pharmaceutical products through its proprietary fusion systems.
